name: Lovart SEO Yearly
description: Annual SEO report (Jan 10). Human approval gate for Y02 content batch.

prompts.prompt:
Generate Lovart SEO annual report for previous calendar year.

1. Aggregate 12 monthly reports from 1-2 Insight/Trident Insights/reports/monthly/
2. Write 1-2 Insight/Trident Insights/reports/yearly/SEO-Annual-YYYY.md
3. bash report-notify --type seo-yearly --status ok --summary "<YoY highlights>" --artifact "<path>"
4. Notion data_source_id 61514ed3-39e2-4d84-b860-8334d740823e Follow-up=__YES__

Gate: Do NOT run year-replace batch unless user approved. List proposals only.
